content: For React SPAs without backend: IndexedDB via Dexie for structured habit/completion data (async, queryable, >5MB). localStorage only for tiny prefs (theme). Export/import: serialize DB to JSON Blob + download link; import via FileReader + transactional Dexie bulkPut with Zod schema validation. Avoid RxDB/TanStack DB — sync/replication overhead unnecessary for v1.
